note: CLN3-associated retinal degeneration prominently features an electronegative ERG or severe generalized rod-cone attenuation/extinction reflecting inner retinal/bipolar cell dysfunction rather than isolated rod dysfunction.

evidence.text: Among eight children evaluated with juvenile Batten disease (CLN3), full-field ERG showed an electronegative waveform in four patients (50%) and undetectable responses in the remaining four.

source.title: Juvenile Batten disease (CLN3): detailed ocular phenotype, novel observations, delayed diagnosis, masquerades, and prospects for therapy
source.quote: An electronegative ERG was present in 4 patients (50%), but with additional a-wave reduction, there was an undetectable ERG in the remaining 4 patients.

evidence.text: Patients with JNCL (CLN3) consistently showed severe to profound ERG abnormalities at initial testing, characterized by marked loss of a-wave amplitudes with even greater loss of b-wave amplitudes, producing electronegative configuration waveforms.

source.title: The dystrophic retina in multisystem disorders: the electroretinogram in neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
source.quote: Patients with JNCL invariably showed severe to profound ERG abnormalities when first tested, with essentially no rod-mediated activity and marked loss of a-wave amplitudes with even greater loss of b-wave amplitudes, creating electronegative configuration waveforms.
